name: Routing & App Entry
description: TanStack Router route files under src/routes (dashboard `_app` tree, auth, storefront and tracking) plus the generated route tree, the three Vite entry points (dashboard, /order storefront, /get) and their HTML shells.

name: Feature Modules
description: Domain-specific screens, dialogs and hooks in src/features — menu, inventory, orders, shifts, staff, public ordering, landing, insights, integrations and the other restaurant-management modules.

name: UI Components
description: Reusable presentation layer: Radix-based primitives in src/components/ui, app-level widgets in src/components/app, layout shells, and the global Tailwind stylesheet.

name: Data & API Client
description: Orval-generated React Query hooks, Axios client and Zod schemas, MSW mock handlers, Zustand stores and org/branch scope context in src/data.

name: Shared Utilities
description: Cross-cutting helpers in src/lib and src/hooks (formatting, auth guard, route prefetch, Excel export, debounce, theme) plus i18n bootstrap, nav config and test setup.

name: Desktop, Build & CI
description: Tauri desktop shell (Rust sources, Cargo, capabilities, icons), Vite/Vitest/ESLint/Orval/TypeScript config, env files, package manifests, public assets and GitHub Actions deploy/release workflows.

name: Maintenance Scripts
description: One-off Python/Node/shell codemod and patch scripts kept at the repo root and in dashboard_patches for i18n merging, type fixes and page rewrites.

name: Project Documentation
description: Root design/product/handoff docs (README, CLAUDE, DESIGN, PRODUCT, audit and handoff reports), frontend agent test prompts, and misc notes/logs.

name: Agent Skill References
description: Vendored Claude/Copilot agent skill packs (impeccable, remotion-best-practices) under .agents, .claude and .github, plus tool workspace config in .claude, .impeccable, .ua and .tanstack.
